lines.cyr: да се кренам, да се извишам,
lines.lat: da se krenam, da se izvišam,
lines.en: to rise, to lift myself up,
to sing a hymn to him.

lines.cyr: Нека расне, о боже, родот убав мој,
lines.lat: Neka rasne, o bože, rodot ubav moj,
lines.en: May it grow, O God, my beautiful people,

lines.cyr: златен дожд од мудрост долго нека пие.
lines.lat: zlaten dožd od mudrost dolgo neka pie.
lines.en: may it drink a golden rain of wisdom for long.

lines.cyr: Нека биде, о боже, вечен родот мој,
lines.lat: Neka bide, o bože, večen rodot moj,
lines.en: May it be, O God, my people eternal,

lines.cyr: нека е што не сме ние.
lines.lat: neka e što ne sme nie.
lines.en: may it be what we are not.
so that I may sow fertile seed,
so that honey-sweet wheat is born,
